abstract: For the roller pass matching problem under a given hot rolling planning, two cases of the problem are considered in this paper: (1) static roller pass matching problem (SRPM) with non-recycled rollers, (2) dynamic roller pass matching problem (DRPM) with recycled rollers. To describe both of the two cases, a 0-1 integer programming formulation is established to minimize the total turning quantity of hot rolling plan. For SRPM, we propose a least turning quantity rule, which is proved successful in finding optimal solution. It is also proved that this rule is effective in finding near-optimal solutions for DRPM. To solve the problems, a heuristic algorithm based on dynamic candidate roller set and least turning quantity rule is proposed. A large number of computational experiments were carried out, and the results show that the algorithm is not only effective but also efficient in solving practical instances and simulation experiments.

articleTitle: Real-Time State Analysis of Digitron and Press Plate in Transformer Substations
publicationTitle: 2016 9th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: In this paper we propose a real-time processing technique to analyze the state of different devices located in transformer substations. More specifically, with real-time video streams provided by surveillance system, we focus on two kinds of targets-the digitron and press plate. Our approach process the input video frames with image processing algorithms such as Gaussian blur, binaryzation of grayscale image, morphological operations, skeleton extraction, Hough line detection and coding classification. The experimental results demonstrate that the proposed approach achieves reliable accuracy of analyzing and high computational efficiency, which are required by real-time analyzing of 1080p videos in multi-channels system. The experiments also shows that our approach outcomes existing solutions on the same tasks.

articleTitle: An Argumentation-Based Negotiation Strategy for Fuzzy Negotiation Preferences
publicationTitle: 2016 9th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: In argumentation-based negotiation(ABN), it exchanges argumentation which is able to be understood by agent, and generated by agent argumentative reasoning under a specified semantics of argumentation. Once lacking some logic reasoning, it is impossible to generate argumentation. In addition, without the full information of the opponent's preference, the argumentation of the opponent will not always attack the goals of the negotiator, but perhaps reinforce it. For this reason, on the basis of Dung's argumentation framework which considers that the argumentation relation of negotiator and the opponent is only attack-relationship, a preference-based argumentation framework is extended in which the relation of the argumentation of the opponent and the preference of the negotiator includes not only attack-relationship but also reinforce-relationship. In order to deal with these problems, an argumentation-based negotiation strategy is proposed to assist in generating and evaluating system solutions in ABNSS, which eliminates the influence of fuzzy negotiators' preferences and lacking logic reasoning.

articleTitle: Behavior Model in Large Scale Analytical Simulation System
publicationTitle: 2016 9th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Behavior models play an important role in analytical simulation system. However, weaknesses such as hard modeling, poor expansibility and little flexibility still exist in current models. In this paper, a behavior model is designed, which consists of Rule-based Expert system and Mission Components. The expert system has high efficient and flexible auto-decision capability. Mission Component provides flexible hierarchical architecture. It spares the effort of developers to design complex behavior and provides high flexibility for final users. Experiment results show that this behavior model not only reduces the difficulty of modeling but also improves its expansibility and flexibility.

articleTitle: Cost-Effective Provisioning of Spot Instances in Clouds
publicationTitle: 2016 9th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: This paper describes a resource management and a scheduling policy, spot scheduling algorithm (SpotSA). Infrastructure-as-a-Service providers offers their unused resources in the form of variable-priced virtual machines (VMs), known as "spot instances", at prices significantly lower than their standard fixed-priced resources. The SpotSA addresses the problem of running deadline-constrained computational jobs on a pool of resources that composed solely of spot instances. The SpotSA considers the differences of spot instances in price and performance so that users can run applications quickly and economically. And the SpotSA is a part of the system architecture. The purpose of this system is to help organizations to run computational jobs on dynamically provisioned resources when these organizations do not have a local cluster of resources.

articleTitle: Equilibrium-Research on a Many-to-One Transit System Based on Time-Varying Road Pricing
publicationTitle: 2016 9th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: This paper analyzes the equilibrium distribution of commuters with time-varying road pricing policy on a many-to-one mass transit system during the morning-period. In the transit system, it is assumed that commuters, which depart from different sites, choose a travel strategy with the minimum travel cost, which comprises congestion cost, the cost of travel time, schedule delay cost, fare cost, and so on. This paper also proposes a corresponding equilibrium model with fixed demands and gives two equilibrium properties, i.e., (1) the inequality of the number of commuters boarding adjacent trains and (2) the consistence of the number of commuters boarding at two adjacent stations. Finally, by numerical examples, we verify the equilibrium model and the two properties, investigate the equilibrium distribution of commuters and the effect of time-varying road pricing on the operating efficiency of the system.

articleTitle: Ecological Sound Events Classification Based on Time-Frequency Features
publicationTitle: 2016 9th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: In order to improve the accuracy of environmental sound events recognition under non-stationary noise, a sound events recognition method based on time-frequency analysis was proposed. In this method, power spectrum of the signal was firstly output in the form of time-frequency diagram. Then, sum and difference histograms(SDH) was adopted to calculate texture features. Afterwards, the matching pursuit(MP) algorithm was employed to obtain effective time-frequency features to supplement the texture features to yield higher recognition accuracy. Two experiments were conducted to demonstrate the effectiveness of these joint features for unstructured environmental sound events classification. The results show that the method can produce good performance, and is robust to noise.

articleTitle: A Fusion of Granulation and Artificial Neural Network: A New Service Selection Method
publicationTitle: 2016 9th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Since similar-functioned web services are gradually increasing in Semantic Web of Things, it's difficult for users to select services they need quickly and efficiently. To solve this problem, this paper proposes a mono-service oriented selection method - Granular Computing Neural Network Service Selection (GCNNSS), which combines Granular Computing with Back-propagation Artificial Neural Network (BPANN). Firstly, match users' service request description with services in services repository to generate satisfying candidate services set. Then, filter the original attribute set of candidate services by service graining, using the minimum attribute set algorithm to get minimum attribute set of original attribute set. Finally, reorder the candidate service set by using the iterative learning method of BPANN and return the result to users. According to the contrast research and simulation experiment, the proposed method GCNNSS is superior to other representative service selection methods in effectiveness and reliability.

articleTitle: A Privacy Filtering and Processing Model in Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2016 9th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Privacy protection in cloud computing environment has become the key to the rapid development of cloud computing, until now more researches have being placed on preserving methods of privacy, but less on filtering and preserving them efficiently. A two-stages filtering model is designed in this paper to solve the problem. The privacy filtering and processing methods are designed correspondingly. The effect and effectiveness are fully considered too. The dynamic blocking algorithm can effectively improve the difficulty of reverting original data and privacy discovery by statistic. The effectiveness of the model is proved at the end by theoretical proof.

articleTitle: A Cross-Corpus Recognition of Emotional Speech
publicationTitle: 2016 9th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: A cross-corpus classification of emotional speech on two datasets, Emo-DB in German and DES in Danish is investigated in this paper. 2-D classifications on arousal-appraisal space leads to significant improvement than in one-step classifications. Emotions are better recognized in arousal dimension than in appraisal dimension. The best classification rate in the cross-corpus test is achieved on male speech samples as 74.83%, when Emo-DB dataset is used as training set and DES as testing set. The classification rate far higher than chance level shows there exists universal mechanisms in expressing emotions by human voice over different languages.

articleTitle: Real-Time Correction Method for Non-follow-Up Dome-Screen Projector System
publicationTitle: 2016 9th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: The purpose of this paper is to realize the real time correction of geometric distortion of the non-follow-up dome-screen used in the motion simulator. To achieve this goal, the change of the trainer's observation area and the observing position that deviate from eye point are analyzed first, when the relative movement of the dome-screen and platform occurs. Then, based on the analysis above, we use the asymmetric view frustum method to make the image zone always in the center of occupant's view. The geometric distortion caused by the deviation the relative movement between the screen and platform is discussed later. Finally, combined with the motion of the visual system, an adaptive visual adjustment method is proposed to reduce the geometric distortion as well as realize the real time correction. The simulation is built on the Matlab. Results indicate that the geometric distortion is reduced about 70% after correction, the distortion error precision is within 0.2° in the zone about 10° around the line of sight. Also the error of the view edge is decreased partly. It is concluded that the method can realize real-time distortion correction only a few transforms and have an excellent effect for non-follow-up dome screen when the relative movement of platform occurs, which satisfies the requirements of the motion simulator.

articleTitle: Some Identities Related to Restricted Lattice Paths
publicationTitle: 2016 9th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Notations and techniques from discrete mathematics play an important role in computer science. In this paper, by applying the concatenation of some restricted lattice paths, we derive the combinatorial interpretations of several identities.

articleTitle: An Agent-Based Simulation Framework for Equipment Support Command
publicationTitle: 2016 9th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: With the difficulty to define equipment support command process with a formal mathematical formula, a simulation model framework for equipment support command is created. This paper introduces firstly the theory of Agent-Based Modeling (ABM) and its technical structures, analyzes the process of equipment support command. According to the characteristics of equipment support and the method of ABM, an agent-based simulation framework of Equipment Support Command is then presented. Each agent module design and its internal communication mechanism in this framework are addressed.

articleTitle: Weak Signal Parameters Estimate Methods Based on Chaotic DFD (Differential Frequency Disturbance)
publicationTitle: 2016 9th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: The chaotic system is very sensitive to the frequency of input weak signal, we select a fightable input signal as a standard base signal, then a harmonic weak signal are put in. We adjust the frequency of standard signal gradually, the motivation of chaotic critical state will change greatly, the numerical result prove that when the standard signal frequency equal to the frequency of harmonic weak signal, the power spectrum of chaotic system will turn to be increase, the input harmonic signal frequency will be calculated. The DFD(Differential frequency disturbance) methods are introduced in this paper, we give detail process of how to estimate weak signal parameters use this methods, the numeric analysis prove that the differential frequency disturbance method of solve the chaotic weak harmonic signal parameter estimation give great low SNR, it has very high estimate precision result.

articleTitle: Studying for the State Monitoring Time of HTPB Propellant
publicationTitle: 2016 9th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Using the finite element analysis to draw a certain type of HTPB propellent on duty in the natural storage and carrier state of stress - time curve, using the linear cumulative damage theory, the HTPB propellent of cumulative damage in both conditions are simulated and calculated the two states of cumulative damage factor, discuss the engine timing of NDT.

articleTitle: Optimization of Biomass Curing Mold
publicationTitle: 2016 9th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: In order to seek the optimal structure parameters of biomass curing mold, based on the FEA software ANSYS and the orthogonal experiment design method, the length to diameter ratio, the conicity of the mold and the friction coefficient were taken as the experimental factors, the extrusion force in the whole forming process was taken as the experimental index, the effect of the experimental factors to the experimental index were studied. The results showed that the effect on the energy consumption of biomass curing is obvious which is caused by the friction coefficient and the length to diameter ratio, the optimal results of the length to diameter ratio, the conicity of the mold and the friction coefficient are 5.25, 45°, and 0.1, respectively. This provides the theoretical basis and reference for the optimization design of biomass curing mold.

articleTitle: Blind Image Quality Assessment via Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2016 9th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: This paper proposed a novel blind image quality assessment method that is created by training a convolutional neural network to learn discriminant features of image quality and fitting the features with a support vector regression to get an evaluation score. The pooling procedure is help to reduce the feature dimension and improve computation efficiency. The proposed method does not need any hand-crafted features contrast with most previous BIQA methods. It achieves better performance than previous BIQA methods on LIVE database. The experimental results show that the proposed method has good consistency, robustness and efficiency.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Usefulness of Online Reviews Based on Different Moderating Effects
publicationTitle: 2016 9th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Goods online review has become the important reference factors that influencing customers to buy online, we have some improvements which are based on the existing manual annotation of useful variables, what the score deviation and the detailed degree are put forward, then from the angle of review content and reviewers to study the influence factors of online review usefulness. Through the empirical analysis, we find that user type has no obvious effect on the usefulness, while the score and the text length have a positive influence on review usefulness and moderated by the effects of score deviation, detailed degree of review, the time interval and location, as well as the commodity brand. This article has provided a new direction and theoretical basis for the research of online reviews usefulness in future.

articleTitle: An Algorithm to Identify High-Bandwidth Flows Based on Packet Drop History
publicationTitle: 2016 9th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: The cache management technology based on packet drops is an important functional module as the packet forwarding device. A BDH-RED (RED with Based on Drop History)algorithm was proposed to identify high-bandwidth flows in times of congestion. The algorithm would keep these flows state if some flows happened to drop packets, based on the method which the number of packet drop was roughly proportional to the arrival rate from a flow. The algorithm computed the number of drop in packet drop history in the routers, uses combined drop ratio, and efficiently identified high-bandwidth flows in the coexistence environment between the normal TCP flows and high-bandwidth flows. By the comparison of existed drop ratio and combined drop ratio, the simulations proved that BDH-RED can efficiently identify high-bandwidth flows.

articleTitle: Firm Role, Innovation Capability and Alliance Network: An Empirical Analysis Based on Chinese Communication Equipment Industry
publicationTitle: 2016 9th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Considering the structural characteristic and resource characteristic of firm in alliance network, this paper defines and divides the firm role into four categories, including the "poor", the "warehouse", the "hub" and the "trump". What's more, this paper takes the firm alliance of Chinese communication equipment industry between 2000 and 2008 as research object to analyze ea ch firm role's innovation capability, and also gives advices to improve innovation accordingly. The results show that the innovation capability of different firm role is different significantly. The "poor" firm has the weakest innovation capability, and whether the "trump" is strongest at innovation can't be verified. The "warehouse" firm has stronger innovation capability than the "hub", that is, the positive effect of resource characteristic on innovation capability is more than structural characteristic's.

articleTitle: Optimization Analysis on Steel Module Lifting System
publicationTitle: 2016 9th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: The tower of the lifting system is the key equipment which ensures the modules being lifted and installed on the deep sea oil extraction platform. As the important bearing structure in the lifting system, the tower has complex force conditions and its quality has great influence on the working performance of the whole lifting system. In terms of the designed gantry tower structure, this paper will use the length and wall thickness of the steel pipe of the gantry tower system as the design variables, the minimum total weight of the tower system as the objective function, the strength and stiffness of the tower system as the constraints. The gantry tower structure is the direct load-bearing structure of the lifting system. Conducting optimization analysis on the gantry tower structure will significantly reduce its weight, make its structure simpler and more reasonable, thus increasing its dependability.

articleTitle: Collaborative Contextual Anomaly Detection for Industrial Equipment Groups
publicationTitle: 2016 9th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: It is challenging to evaluate the degradation of equipment using data-driven approach, especially for those nonlinear industrial systems working in dynamic environment. In this work, we propose a collaborative contextual anomaly detection method that clusters similar devices with same context into collaborative groups, builds degradation profile for each device, then detects anomalies by comparing the profiles in each groups.

articleTitle: Study on Segmentation-Based HEVC Compression Performance
publicationTitle: 2016 9th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Since the improvement of high efficient video coding (HEVC) compression ratio is yet not studied completely, a new segmentation-based image compression coding frame is realized in this paper. The compression performance of this coding frame is further improved by taking the coding standard HEVC as a basic part of image compression, using the characteristics of HEVC intra coding and inter coding as well as segmentation. Combined with the traditional coding frame HEVC, the frame is to fully use the excellent compression performance of existing standard frames, thus, fundamentally, ensuring the compression performance of the frame is proposed. Experimental results show that, at low bitrate section, the compression performance of the frame proposed is much better than that of HEVC.

articleTitle: System Design of Three Dimensional Adjusting Device for Large Structure Block Merging
publicationTitle: 2016 9th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Based on the modular design of marine equipment, this paper aims at designing the mechanical model, working system, hydraulic system and control system of the three dimensional adjusting device applied for the large structure block merging. In this paper, the position control and synchronous control of the multi cylinders are achieved. According to the demand, the velocities of different cylinders can be controlled proportionally. Owing to these, six degrees of freedom adjustment can be realized. So it improves the efficiency and automation of the block merging for module structures which are large size, large tonnage and complex structure, it also satisfies the precision, ensures the safety of the site.

articleTitle: FPGA of Bias-Free Distorters RF Power Amplifiers and Front Ends Design for Computational Intelligence Applications
publicationTitle: 2016 9th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: A digital third-order MASH 1-1-1 delta-sigma (ΔΣ) modulator (DSM) is designed and implemented on field programmable gate array (FPGA) customer board (Lyrtech) in fractional-N phase-locked loop (PLL). Fractional-N frequency synthesizers have many advantages over their conventional counterparts, integer-N synthesizers. The proposed paper combine with parallel forward-reverse Schottky-diode paths and a π-type attenuator form a bias-free predistorter that effectively reduces the intermodulation distortion (IMD) of a RF power amplifier by electronic design automation (EDA) form computational intelligence techniques. The predistorter exhibits a constant insertion loss at the low input power and its insertion loss decreases when the input power increases. An improvement of extended operating power level up to 5.7 dB with the limit of -30dBm adjacent-channel leakage power (ACLP) is obtained for a 2-watt amplifier at 5.8 GHz. Measured results are presented to illustrate the effectiveness of the predistorter.

articleTitle: A Rating Charge Model of Transfer Tax for China's Interprovincial Air Pollution Control
publicationTitle: 2016 9th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: In this paper, we established a rating charge model of transfer tax (RCTT) to solve transboundary air pollution control problem of China. Firstly, by using the bi-level nonlinear programming model. In this model, the leader is China's central government and the followers consist of China's 31 provinces. The leader aims to decrease the nation's total pollutant control costs, whereas each province attempts to minimize its pollution control costs by balancing its own pollutant reduction cost with transfer tax to or from other provinces, in the context of a transfer tax rate set by the leader. Then, we used the SO2 reduction amount of Beijing, Tianjin and Hebei province from 2003 to 2009 as an example to fit the environmental damage cost of air pollutants. Finally, the optimal solution of RCTT model was compared with Provincial Territorial Management Model based on basic data. The results showed that RCTT model not only can make the total cost of pollution control in the whole region is the lowest but also promote cooperation of each administrative region to control the transboundary air pollution.

articleTitle: Bifurcation and Chaos Analysis of Compound Planetary Gear Sets
publicationTitle: 2016 9th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: This paper proposes a new nonlinear time-varying transverse-torsional coupled model for a compound planetary gear sets. In this model, the motion dimensionless differential equations of the gear system are established based on Lagrange equation and the equations are solved, from which the result of the nonlinear dynamic response is obtained. The influences of excitation frequency, damping coefficient and backlash on the bifurcation and chaos characteristics of the system are obtained through dynamic bifurcation diagram, time history curve, phase trajectory and Poincare map. The analysis results show that the coupling of time-varying meshing stiffness, transmission errors, gear backlashes and dimension tolerance make the inner nonlinear dynamic behaviors various for system. Excitation frequency and backlash have strong effects on the dynamic behaviors of the system. The motion state of the system becomes complex within the backlash increasing. The region of chaotic motion would be suppressed and the stable periodic motion would be increased by increasing the damping coefficient. Meanwhile, the routes of period doubling and crisis to chaotic motion were observed under different bifurcation parameters.

articleTitle: Research on Anticipatory Reasoning for Air Traffic Control
publicationTitle: 2016 9th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: In recent years, aviation safety is always under the strong spotlight. According to the statistics, pilot errors account for nearly 60 percent causes of fatal accidents. How to reduce the impact of human factor has become an important issue. After analyzing the problems existing in current Air Traffic Control System, this paper proposes a logic system called STDERL by adding the concept of spatio-temporal logic, deontic logic and epistemic logic into the strong relevant logic system. Then apply the proposed logic to the domain of air traffic control and propose a reasoning model, which is verified by a real air traffic scene about autonomous flights of multiple aircrafts. The model with STDERL has turned out to be an effective way to improve the current situation of aviation industry.

articleTitle: Research of Large-Scale Terrain Data Organization Method in Virtual Reality
publicationTitle: 2016 9th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Summarized the mainly algorithms of terrain three-dimensional visualization in virtual reality, for the large-scale terrain data organization in three-dimensional virtual war zone simulation, analyzed the characteristic of change of scene, according to motion regulation and idea of layer and block, presented the organize principle of external static data and terrain blocks index regulation, for the large system pressure in the process of scene update, synthesize available visibility culling methods, for the scene change with large-scale data, the system could operate in a high frame rate.

articleTitle: Adaptive Inverse Control for Two-Links Flexible Manipulator
publicationTitle: 2016 9th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: The elastic vibrations of two-link manipulators are decoupled from the flexible manipulator for vertical planar two-links flexible manipulators. And the system was decomposed into two subsystems, slow-changing subsystem and fast-changing subsystem. An adaptive inverse controller based on model-reference is established for slow-changing subsystem. The fast-changing subsystem was deal with as disturb signal from system. The simulation results show that the proposed method not only can accurately and fast track the tip trajectory of manipulator, but also can effectively damp the elastic vibrations of two links manipulator, and is strongly robust to the variation of system parameters. The characteristic of this method is that each equivalent vibration parameters can be adaptively estimated and compensated respectively, so it is simple and easy to implement.

articleTitle: Modeling and Correlation Analysis between Complex Networks
publicationTitle: 2016 9th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Link prediction in complex network often focuses on the single network in many fields and develops a lot of methods. However, the relationship between two dependent networks with specific global structure has hardly caught attention, but only the local topology analysis. In this paper, we aim to infer the correlation of two high dimensional dependent networks based on the similar nodes' attributes but in distinct measurement. By means of the singular value decomposition (SVD) method, we extract the model factor characteristics behind the network as latent variables to efficiently express low dimensional information, and construct linear model to estimate the parameter. We also predict and impute missing values of two networks mutually. The simulation results show the performance of model and inference quite good in the case of small sample size.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Particle Swarm Optimization for Parallel Machine Scheduling with Shared and Multi-mode Resources
publicationTitle: 2016 9th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: In this paper, we present a parallel machine scheduling with shared and multi-mode resources (PMS-SMR) problem which is widely encountered in manufacturing engineering. The integer programming for this problem is given and a hybrid particle swarm optimization (HPSO) algorithm is put forward with a problem-based solution representation and a balancing optimization (BO)-based local search. The HPSO algorithm can be applied to obtain the best permutation of the fitness function with least-makespan optimization criterion. Experimental results show that it is feasible and effective, especially in solving large-scale problems.

articleTitle: Research on Elements of Urban Design Competitiveness
publicationTitle: 2016 9th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Design industry has become the new engine of economic growth in background of global integration. Design is a unique resource which integrates decision-making skills and specific implementation capacity. It transforms the abstract scientific thinking into the concrete productivity. The promotion of urban design ability can greatly promote the development of social economy. In this paper, we analyzed the determinants and internal mechanism of urban design competitiveness, extracted the elements and evaluation indicators, and laid the theoretical foundation for the further construction of the evaluation model. It has a great significance for the cities to recognize their own advantages and disadvantages.

articleTitle: Wind Turbine Dynamic State Prediction Method Based on the Similarity of Historical Data
publicationTitle: 2016 9th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: This paper proposes a wind turbine dynamic state prediction method using similarity matching in historical data. Because similarity matching is inefficient for large-scale multivariate time series (MTS) data, we use feature selection method based on random forest to determine main attributes and remove irrelevant attributes. Then, by using the principal component analysis, the dimension of MTS data can be reduced into one dimension. After that, we search the most similar historical data for a given current synthetic attribute time series, and then use the consequent data of the chosen historical data as the predicting state of the wind turbine. Theoretical analysis and experimental results show that the proposed method is robust and effective.

articleTitle: Surrogate-Based Global Sequential Sampling Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2016 9th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: To improve research efficiency of engineering problems, Surrogate model has gained its popularity in replacing real engineering model. This paper proposes a kind of Global Sequential Sampling Algorithm (GSSA) based on surrogate model. With the process of iteration, GSSA can sample both in unexplored region and large-error region, then iteratively update the samples. OLHS is used as initial sampling method. Crossover operator which is employed in Genetic Algorithm (GA) is adopted to generate candidate sample assembly each iteration, Candidate sample with maximum weight product of cross validation error and minimum distance from existing samples will be chosen as newly added sample. At last a global surrogate model is built with all samples. GSSA is compared to MSE approach, CV-Voronoi Algorithm, and OLHS method on several test functions and results validate its effectiveness.

articleTitle: Efficient Mining Algorithm of Frequent Itemsets for Uncertain Data Streams
publicationTitle: 2016 9th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: With the rapid development of computer technology, web services has been widely used. In these applications, the uncertain data is in the form of streams. In view of this kind of situation, present a new generalized data structure, that is, PSUF - tree, to store uncertain data streams, all itemsets in recent window are contained in global PStree in a condensed format, establish a header table in which contains dynamic array of expected value whose header table saved the same itemsets. Based on PSUF-tree, present a new mining algorithm for frequent itemsets, that is, PSUF-streaming algorithm, frequent itemsets could be mined by traversing the dynamic array, the maintaining of PSUF-tree just handles the header table corresponds to the oldest batch of itemsets in window. The experimental results show that PSUF-streaming algorithm has good efficiency and scalability, and reduce memory usage to some extent.

articleTitle: Research in the Investment Decision Based on Missing Data
publicationTitle: 2016 9th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: In order to solve the investment decision problem with missing data. Multiple imputation theory, Bayesian theory were used to design a basic process of investment decision. Firstly, multiple imputation was applied to interpolate the missing data, then the Bayesian decision was made, finally, the risk of decisions made under different situations was compared by fault tree method, and the investment of new energy vehicles was used for empirical analysis, the result shows that using the new decision-making process we proposed can reduce the risk of failure by about 5 percent.

articleTitle: Study on Brand Prominence and Brand Preference of Business Gifts
publicationTitle: 2016 9th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: It is important to think about which is the best way to show a brand on the business gifts in order to achieve the best publicity effect. This study provides a theoretical basis for the design method of the corporate brand on the business gifts by researching the influencing factors of brand prominence and brand preference in different usage scenarios, building the model of study method and applying multi-factor analysis of variance. This study can be used for reference if the field of business gifts design and brand promotion and has certain theoretical value and a broad application prospect.

articleTitle: Text Clustering Algorithm Based on Semantic Graph Structure
publicationTitle: 2016 9th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: As semantic information is often missing in text representation, this paper proposes semantic graph structure to represent text and optimize graph structure by semantic similarity matrix. Then calculate the similarity of semantic graph structure by using the maximum common sub-graph of graph theory. Finally, K-means algorithm will be applied to expand Chinese text clustering to improve text clustering effect. Experimental results show that the proposed algorithm based on semantic graph structure is more conducive for the representation of semantic information. It significantly improves the accuracy of text similarity in the text similarity measure and will be applied to text clustering to further improve the effect of text clustering by adjusting the corresponding parameters.

articleTitle: Heuristic Difference Algorithm for Scheduling Flowshop with Limited Storage in Chemical Industry
publicationTitle: 2016 9th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: This paper studies the typical problem of scheduling flowshop with limited storage in process industry. The optimization objective of this problem is to minimize the makespan by arranging batch size and time. Heuristic difference algorithm(HDA) is presented. The computational results show that the HDA may find optimal or suboptimal solutions in a short run time for all the instances.

articleTitle: Gas Stations Oriented Internet Service System Based on Intel Minnowboard
publicationTitle: 2016 9th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: This work is an intelligent gas station information collection and exchange system based on the Intel processor, Minnowboard. Aim to obtain real-time data include tanks' status, guns' status and billing information from gas stations through the sensor device placed on each station. The Sensor Controllers connect to oil tanks and oil guns, to collect real time data, and then transmit these data to the server running on the Minnow IoT(Internet of Things) gateway by a network protocol WebSocket. After the server processes the data, it stores and updates the information in the cloud server database. At the same time, publishing these data to WeChat terminal for a real-time display, through another protocol, MQTT(Message Queuing Telemetry Transport). This system effectively improve the automatic management level of oil stations. In the near future, the system accomplish online payments and so on, That would be a direction for the petrochemical field in the future.

articleTitle: Design of Testing & Identification System of Electronic Recycling Equipment for Certain Missile Based on Support Vector Machine
publicationTitle: 2016 9th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Given the fact of unscientific treatment of electronic recycling equipment in a type of missile and mass waste of reusable resources, and basing on in-depth study of the characteristics of faults with electronic recycling equipment in such missile, systematic analysis is made regarding fundamental principles of maintainability appraisal of electronic recycling equipment in such missile, with general technical plan for maintainability appraisal system integrating testing by slave computer, fault locating with host computer and calculation of maintenance cost proposed, and innovative method for locating the fault in module unit or key component by embedding support vector machine(SVM) into expert system inference machine, and fault diagnosis expert system is contrived based on SVM, together with scheme of hardware and software design offered for slave computer testing system, intending to guide and for reference in the development of maintainability appraisal system for electronic recycling equipment in other types of missiles.

articleTitle: Analysis of Tunnel Monitoring Results Based on Modulus Maxima Method of Wavelet Transform
publicationTitle: 2016 9th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: In recent years, the theory and method of wavelet analysis is widely used in signal processing, pattern recognition, data compression, image processing and quantum physics. Compared with modulus maxima, wavelet packet decomposition and coefficient shrinkage de-noising method of wavelet transform, their advantages and disadvantages are analysed and summarized, and their respective scopes are obtained. The Noissin chosen as the original signal with noise is analysed and de-noised by the modulus maxima method of wavelet transform, meanwhile the usage conditions and key computing parameters are also obtained. Finally, the modulus maxima method of wavelet transform are successfully adopted to de-noised the monitoring results of shield tunnel, the data revised are reliably provided for tunnel healthy diagnosis.

articleTitle: A Discrete Artificial Bee Colony Algorithm for Permutation Flow Shop Scheduling
publicationTitle: 2016 9th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: A discrete artificial bee colony algorithm (DABC) is proposed for solving the permutation flow shop scheduling problem (PFSSP) with minimum makespan criterion. Firstly, the NEH heuristic was combined the random initialization to the population for quality and diversity. Secondly, a new individual enhancement scheme is proposed to combine the swap, insert, inverse and adjacent exchange operation. Third, the fast local search is used to enhancing the individuals. Fourth, the pair-wise based local search is used to enhance the global optimal solution and escape from local minimum. Lastly, simulations and comparisons based on PFSSP benchmarks are carried out, which show that our algorithm is effectively and efficiently for solving the PFSSP.

articleTitle: Study on Modeling and Scheduling Optimization Algorithm of Mining-Excavation Planning
publicationTitle: 2016 9th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: The mining-excavation plan plays an important part in the operation management and business intelligence system construction of the mining enterprise and has great impact on decision-making of the mining enterprise. This paper takes the decision support system underground metal mine as the research object and studies its model and algorithm. Based on goals and constraints of ore blending operations, the ore blending model is established by using the theory and technology of multiobjective programming and the ore blending plan is optimized, which provides the theoretical basis and data support for the mining-excavation planning. Based on the experience and knowledge of domain experts and constraints of mining, the stope superseding and verification model is established by using the experts system and its inference mode, therefore the stoping sequence of ore blocks is worked out. In view of the cost characteristics of underground mining the mining-excavation planning model is established by using the time Petri net extended with price information, thus the minimum production cost and corresponding mining-excavation plan are worked out by using the above model.

articleTitle: Group-Based Argumentation
publicationTitle: 2016 9th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: The abstract argumentation framework can only deal with the attack relations between single arguments and not allow the attack relations among the sets of arguments. However, there usually are various attack relations among groups in realistic applications of argumentation. In this paper, we propose a group-based argumentation framework, which allows us to cope with the attack relation among the sets of arguments. We define the annotate arguments to describe the groups of arguments, in which the arguments of a group have the same standpoint. We then provide the semantics and properties of the group-based argumentation, respectively. The abstract argumentation framework without self-attacks can be viewed as a special case of the group-based argumentation framework.

articleTitle: A New Geometric Representation for Tree-Structured Robots
publicationTitle: 2016 9th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: In order to solve the disaccord resulted from the existing frame assignment conventions, we propose a modified Denavit-Hartenberg parameters for tree-structured robots, which can be used for kinematic and dynamic modelling simultaneously. Then, the new frame assignment method is used to our designed rehabilitation robots which it has 17 freedoms and the whole body control is introduced to render the robot working in a corporative way such that the difficult leg-lifting rehabilitation is fulfilled. Numerical computation shows that, the derived kinematic and dynamic models are not only very useful to optimize the robot's mechanical structure in the early design stage, but also they can be used to implement motion control of the robot, to carry out intensity correction for key parts and to improve control performance in the future applications.

articleTitle: Hybrid Modeling Graphic Images to Urban Scene
publicationTitle: 2016 9th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Urban scene modeling is a promising research subject, for it plays an important role in the areas of national defense, transportation, urban planning, and entertainment industries. Researchers have been looking forward to the breakthroughs in improving the level of photorealism and the performance. This paper discusses the implementation of the simulation of certain parts of city scene. We use the graphics mixed modeling to generate a variety of architectural models. Graphics hybrid modeling is a method to generate 3D models of given objects by conducting image processing and 3D calculation on geometric characteristics extracted from their three-view drawings. Experiments show that the method of large-scale scene image hybrid modeling improves the rendering efficiency without decreasing the level of photorealism.

articleTitle: Eclipse Period GEO Satellite Energy Switching Time Prediction Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2016 9th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: In the general way, routine eclipse prediction methods can only provide starting and ending time prediction. However it cannot give us accurate sate switch time prediction. It does not ensure satellites safety. This paper brings up a new GEO satellite energy switching time calculation algorithm in eclipse period. This method not only provides accurate eclipse starting and ending time predication, but also offers the precision state switch time of energy system. It is very efficient to enhance the satellite monitor in eclipse period. The algorithm has been successfully applied to several GEO satellites in-orbit operation.

articleTitle: Location Similarity Based Replica Node Detection for Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2016 9th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: The node replica attack is known to be dangerous to wireless sensor networks (WSNs) because it enables the adversary to extend the damage throughout the network with very low cost. To stop such attack, we propose a similarity estimation based scheme with group deployment knowledge. Compared with prior works, our proposal provides extra functionality that prevent replica from generating false location claims. Through simulation experiment, we evaluate the performance of the proposed scheme and demonstrate that our scheme achieves effectiveness and efficiency under different situations and attack strategies.

articleTitle: Study and Evaluation on the Performance of CLEANCOOL Seamless Sports Knitted Fabrics
publicationTitle: 2016 9th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Due to the global economic growth and the changes in people's living habits, sports is becoming more and more important in people's life. In the hot and humid environment of the sports, how to keep the wearer's clothes dry and cool is particularly significant. With the function of moisture absorption and quick drying, the anti-bacterial and odor-resistant seamless sports fabrics can provide a good environment for the wearer. This study used CLEANCOOL and polyester to orthogonally interweave with nylon respectively. As a result, we get 9 different kinds of fabric and know the relationship between three factors (materials, interwoven proportion, organization structure) and the fabric performances (elastic reply rate, moisture permeability and so on). We obtain a kind of seamless sportswear fabric that can do a good job of moisture absorption, quick drying and is anti-bacterial and odor-resistant.

articleTitle: Research on Project Cost Optimization under Constraint of System Reliability
publicationTitle: 2016 9th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Construction engineering is considered as a complex network system project. By analyzing the relationship of construction costs and reliability in engineering project, a mathematical model is established to optimize the costs and genetic algorithm (GA) is used for this purpose. In the application of GA, penalty function is used to handle the constraint. Ranking based on the evaluation function and optimal conservation are adopted in the selection strategy which improve the convergence performance of GA. Finally, an example is given to verify the advantage of the new method which combines the reliability with economy in the construction. The paper is benefit for the cost optimization research.

articleTitle: Cluster Impulsive Noise Suppression Approach for Broadband Power-Line Communication Systems
publicationTitle: 2016 9th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Signal transmission on power-line is always affected by impulsive noise. The most common way of suppressing impulsive noise is to adopt nonlinear preprocessing for noisy signals before OFDM demodulation at the receiver, and one of the most simple and effective method is blanking suppression technology. Impulsive noise according to different types can be divided into Bernoulli Gaussian model and cluster model. Blanking suppression method is remarkable for Bernoulli Gaussian impulsive noise, but for cluster impulsive noise, simple blanking suppression is equivalent to rectangular window handle, can bring obvious spectrum leakage problem. Therefore, this paper proposes a suppression method only for cluster impulsive noise of broadband power-line communication systems. OFDM signal at receiver firstly process discrete Fourier transform, extract guard band signal from the output, combine with time and frequency domain method to estimate the relevant parameters of the impulsive noise, and then build a proper envelope window function on the basis of previous blanking suppression method to inhibit cluster impulsive noise in time domain according to the estimated parameters. This method can not only suppress impulsive noise effectively, but also greatly avoid the spectrum leakage, further improve the performance of the broadband power-line communication systems.

articleTitle: An Efficient Association Mining Method via Matrix Compression
publicationTitle: 2016 9th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: With the development of computer network technology and popularization, and the technology of data acquisition, data management and data query develop rapidly. People who is in the surging "data ocean", need an intelligent technology badly, to "explore" more valuable "oil "from the "data ocean",so the data mining technology which has been successfully used in commercial, medical, financial, and other fields, emerges. The primary technology of data mining is classification analysis, cluster analysis, Association Rule analysis, and etc. Association Rule analysis is an important branch of data mining, which can extract the valuable associations or rules people want to know from data warehouse. Based on the background of "data platform for public petition", it aims to study how to combine the Association Rule analysis technology with the current massive government-data, extracting association information from the massive hidden government-data, which can provide userful and valuable information according to the practical significance of the associations for system managers and decision makers. This paper study the classic Association Rule algorithm Apriori, propose the improved Apriori algorithm based on matrix com-pression. Based on this improved Apriori algorithm, develop the module of the analysis of cases evaluation, which can associate the cases and case handlers according to the information of cases and case handlers fistly, and then get the practical significance from the association result analysis, which can provide help to the managers and decision makers.

articleTitle: A New Family of Asymptotically Optimal 2-D Optical Orthogonal Codes
publicationTitle: 2016 9th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: In application, good OOCs have the property that each codeword has many more 0s than 1s. The code length of a conventional 1D-OOC is always large in order to achieve good bit error rate performance. However, long code sequences will occupy a large bandwidth and reduce the bandwidth utilization. 1D-OOCs also suffer from relatively small cardinality. The 2D-OOCs overcome both of these shortcomings. In this paper, we present a new family of 2-D (Λ × T, ω, κ ) wavelength/time optical orthogonal codes (2D-OOCs) by projective geometry theory. Function clusters over finite fields are used in the construction. The codes presented are asymptotically optimal with respect to the bound given by Omrani et al. which is an adaptation of the Johnson's bound for OPPW codes.

articleTitle: Behavior Analysis of VanDerPol Oscillator Based on Phase Space Reconstruction Methods
publicationTitle: 2016 9th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: VanDerPol oscillator behavior under the excitation of weak signal is researched in this paper, the methods of phase space reconstruction analysis can realized the chaotic model, it help us to figure out the parameters of chaotic system. We give ways of how to select the parameters of time delay value and embedding dimension in phase space reconstruction, we select the VanDerPol oscillator to analysis the different parameters influence on chaotic system, the numeric analysis prove that if select appropriate embedding dimension and delay time, the remodeling results can reflect the dynamic characteristics of the original signal.

articleTitle: Looking for Information Source from Online Social Network with Incomplete Observation
publicationTitle: 2016 9th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Online social network has become an important media for information spreading. To target the origin of rumors and well understand the cause of event, information source in social network should be found out. Unfortunately, because of the huge and complex structure of social network, it is nearly impossible to monitor the complete online social network. To solve this problem, the paper gives a method to look for information source with incomplete observation. The basis of the method is the correlation between activated time and network topology structure. Some experiments are executed and the effect of different sampling methods was analyzed as well. Experiments on BA, WS and Facebook show that the method can produce satisfied results with incomplete observation.

articleTitle: The Unknown Input Reconstruction and Reduced-Order Observer Design of Discrete Time T-S Fuzzy System
publicationTitle: 2016 9th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: The paper considers the problems of the design of a reduced-order observer, the state estimation and unknown input reconstruction for a class of discrete time Tagaki-Sugeno (T-S) fuzzy system inputs when the observer matching condition is not satisfied. First, an auxiliary output vector is constructed to satisfy the observer matching condition. Then, a reduced-order observer is designed for accurate estimation of system states. And then combining with auxiliary output using iterative matrix the output are obtained. Based on this, the immeasurable output are obtained by the matrix methods. And by means of the auxiliary output an unknown input reconstruction method is proposed. Finally, a numerical simulation is used to illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed methods which not only estimates the states of the original system, but also reconstructs the unknown input.

articleTitle: Distribution of Frame Coefficients
publicationTitle: 2016 9th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Frame coefficients play an important role in the study of frame theory, which helps in the structural analysis of applications for frames. However, we know very little about the distribution of frame coefficients sequences. In this paper, we mainly study the distribution of the frame coefficients for vectors in a Hilbert space by using the minimum eigenvalue of frame operator. Our results generalize and improve the remarkable results which have been obtained by Brewaster et al. Finally, we present some examples to demonstrate the efficiency of our conclusions.

articleTitle: Object Tracking Using Minimum-Spanning-Tree One-Class Classifier
publicationTitle: 2016 9th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: In the traditional discriminative object tracking methods, similar to the target, background is often taken mistakenly as a single negative class to train two-class classifiers despite including various objects with different distributions. A novel method based on one-class classifier is proposed for object tracking. It takes background as a collection of all other classes except the target. Object tracking is viewed as a one-class classification problem correspondingly. Firstly, the tracking results in the recent few frames are collected as the target training samples. Secondly, a k-nearest-graph is built based on these training samples and the most representative samples are selected on the basis of their own local average degrees to construct a minimum spanning tree. Then an one-class classifier based on the minimum spanning tree is trained to model the target. Lastly the similarity scores of candidates drawn from a particle filter are evaluated by the trained one-class classifier and the one with highest score is taken as the tracking result in current frame and used to update the training sample set and the one-class classifier. Empirical results on challenging video sequences demonstrate the superior performance of our method in robustness and accuracy to state-of-the-art methods.

articleTitle: The Research of Broadcast Television Program Recommendation Technology Based on User Clustering
publicationTitle: 2016 9th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Aiming at the information overload caused by rich resources of Broadcast Television programs, this paper puts forward Broadcast Television Programs Recommendation Technology based on user clustering. According to user rating data and programs broadcasting data, we cluster users by the improved K-MEANS algorithm, divide the users with similar viewing preference into the same community groups, and generate the programs candidate list by the users' viewing preference and trust level in the community, in order to recommend programs to the users. Through formula verification and experimental evaluation, we describe that the effect of Broadcast Television programs recommendation technology based on user clustering is better than the global recommendation technology.

articleTitle: Robust Ranking on Manifold for Salient Object Detection
publicationTitle: 2016 9th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Saliency detection is to find the most important object automatically according to the human visual in the unknown scene. Most existing algorithms detect the salient object using various salient object features. In this paper, we present a novel saliency detection method by an iterated graph Laplacian based ranking on manifolds to determine whether the region is salient or not. Firstly, we segment the input image into several regions, and then compute the ranking function based on a robust graph Laplacian. Secondly, we estimate each region's saliency value using the background and foreground queries respectively. The background queries have determined using analysis of the image edge feature. The foreground queries have produced using the concept called boundary connectivity. Experimental results prove that the proposed algorithm outperforms many of the recent state-of-art and classical algo-rithms.

articleTitle: A Study on the Influence of Bit Error Ratio against Jamming Signal Ratio under Different Channel Jamming
publicationTitle: 2016 9th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: The performance of digital communication systems, depending on the signal modulation and demodulation. In this paper, loading several different jamming pattern to different digital communication modulation system models, the bit error rate(BER) under different conditions of jamming signal ratio(JSR) was in statistics through a large number of statistical simulation, the graph is giving to illustrate the comparative relationship of JSR and BER, the comparative Analysis under different channel jamming pattern is giving to illustrate the influence for different digital communication systems.

articleTitle: Study on User Behavior Prediction Based on Singular Value Decomposition
publicationTitle: 2016 9th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Social network, such as micro-blog, includes the large amount of users' data which reflects the user behavior. The users' behavior, such as emotion and interests can be analyzed effectively through data mining and other means. However, due to the posts, comment and others data in social network are relatively short, the huge dimensionality of the item-document matrix which is built according to these users' data is getting larger and larger with increasing of the number of users and data. In order to improve the efficiency of data analysis, one of the important methods is to reduce the dimensionality of the data matrix. In the paper, singular value decomposition method is used to reduce the data dimensionality, the data matrix with large dimensionality can be mapped to another semantic space with low dimensionality, reducing the cost of the similarity computing between documents. The documents, such as blogs, posts and comments which different users posted, can be divided to different topics, the number of documents in the topics can reflect the state of user emotion and behavior. Experiments show effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Density-Based Algorithm in MapReduce
publicationTitle: 2016 9th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Clusters are well recognized regardless of their shape and of the dimensionality of the space in which they are embedded in traditional CFSFDP (Clustering by fast search and find of density peaks). But when large-scale dataset is processed, it takes too long time to calculate the distance between two data points. In this paper, we present a novel MapReduce-based CFSFDP clustering algorithm called mrCFSFDP that tries to overcome the mentioned shortcoming, mrCFSFDP just reads the dataset once and hence it is several times faster. Each procedure of mrCFSFDP carried out in many nodes is divided into two steps, Map and Reduce. This algorithm is tested on several cases and the experimental results show that this model is feasible and has good performance of accuracy and efficiency.

articleTitle: Research on Assembly Accuracy Control System of Offshore Large Multi-layer Steel Structure
publicationTitle: 2016 9th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Large multi-layer steel structure has high reliability and safety and become more and more widely in construction of offshore oil platform. As error accumulation of large steel structure with multi-layers when manufacturing and installing, it is very hard to realize the accuracy of installation in responsible constructing efficiency. It's usually required to set up accuracy control points with 3D software, and monitor the accuracy control points with the total station to improve the installation accuracy and efficiency. This paper presented a secondary development of AutoCAD with VBA, which develops an assembly accuracy control system to provide layering, accuracy control points setting and measuring data matching functionfor construction of offshore large multi-layer steel structure, and helps analysis installation errors. This system can provide important technical support for the construction of large multi-layer steel structure.

articleTitle: Impact of the Rolling Speed of Chinese Characters on the Visual Search Performance
publicationTitle: 2016 9th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: The display mode of character scrolling has been widely applied in display design. This study mainly aims to examine the impact of different sizes of characters on visual search through the performance of visual search and ratings of subjective difficulties. A total of 12 college students participate in completing the visual search task of the target words in the rolling characters. The study aims to analyze the accuracy of this visual search, the reaction time and the grading results of the search difficulties. The experimental results show that with the decrease of the size of characters and the increase of the rolling speed of characters, the visual search performance will significantly reduce, the rating of the participants' subjective difficulties will improve. However, when the rolling speed is at 20pix/s to 140pix/s, the size of characters may have more effects on the performance than the scrolling speed significantly. Especially when the size is 10 pt, the search performance and subjective evaluation will be dropped significantly. The result of this study provides an advice for the design of the display of the scrolling characters that the character size should be greater than 10pt, and the rolling speed should be higher than 20pix/s.
